svg.aria-label: Stack, as keys on a custom keyboard pressed one after another: C++23 (the core of the Makine launcher), Qt 6 · QML (every screen of the launcher), CMake (builds everything native), Rust (the Makine Discord bot), TypeScript (the websites and their Workers), Cloudflare (Workers · R2 · D1, the edge it all runs on), Unity · C# (CEDRA prototypes and a Unity MCP server), raylib (One Line's engine, native C++ on Android), Kotlin (the Android side), Python (tooling, build scripts, data), Blender (models and renders).
